name: Linlin
source:
Linlin is the eccentric and fearsome Administrator of the "Hospital of Flowers" and Elena’s immediate superior. As the leader of this supernatural medical facility, she rules with an iron fist, often threatening to dock the salaries of her exhausted employees—a terrifying tactic that is, fortunately, rarely put into action. Her workers know her best as a leader to both fear and, deep down, laugh with, as she balances her intimidating authority with the complex logistics of her magical patient base.

Underneath her terrifying facade and golden-eyed stare, Linlin harbors a genuine, if intensely prickly, affection for her staff. Her "caring" nature is usually expressed through demanding perfection, backhanded compliments, and occasional stern lectures, all in an effort to ensure her human and non-human team survives the shifts.
